privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Checkpoint (a service of Omnixys Technologies, Caleb Gyamfi) handles personal data when you use the platform.

controller.title: 1. Controller
controller.text: The controller responsible for data processing is Omnixys Technologies (Caleb Gyamfi), Waiblinger Straße 20A, 70372 Stuttgart, Germany. For any questions regarding data protection you may contact us at any time at caleb.gyamfi@omnixys.com.

collected.title: 2. Data We Collect
collected.text: When you log in and use the platform we process the personal data required for your account and for the events you organise or attend, such as name, email address, phone number and, where applicable, additional guest data. Usage data required to provide and secure the service is also processed.

analytics.title: 3. Analytics
analytics.text: With your consent we use an analytics service to measure page views and usage patterns, so that we can improve the product. This only processes anonymous usage data, such as the pages opened and technical device characteristics. It is not used to identify individual users.

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.text: We use cookies and browser storage for essential functions: a language cookie (locale) remembers your selected language, authentication cookies manage your session, and a consent cookie (omnixys.analytics.consent) records your analytics decision. For security purposes a device key and technical data such as your IP address may be processed. In addition, your browser stores technical data such as secure device credentials and your theme setting.

legalBasis.title: 5. Legal Basis
legalBasis.text: We process personal data on the following legal bases: for the performance of a contract and provision of the requested service (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR), based on your consent (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. a GDPR), and based on our legitimate interest in operating and securing the service (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR).

rights.title: 6. Your Rights
rights.text: You have the right to request access to, rectification of, erasure of, restriction of processing of, and portability of your personal data. You may also object to processing and withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future. You may lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

contact.title: 7. Contact
contact.text: To exercise your rights or for any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at caleb.gyamfi@omnixys.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Please read these Terms of Service carefully before using Checkpoint. By registering or using the platform you agree to these terms.

scope.title: 1. Scope
scope.text: These Terms of Service govern the use of the Checkpoint platform (a service of Omnixys Technologies, Caleb Gyamfi). They apply to all administrators and team members who organise events, manage invitations, scan QR tickets and track attendance.

account.title: 2. Account
account.text: To use the platform you create an account and keep your login credentials secure. You are responsible for all activity performed through your account. Registered contact data must always be kept up to date.

service.title: 3. Service Description
service.text: Checkpoint provides QR-based guest management and event access tools, including invitation management, ticket generation, scanning and attendance tracking. We make reasonable efforts to keep the service available but do not guarantee uninterrupted availability.

userContent.title: 4. Event and Guest Data
userContent.text: You remain responsible for the event and guest data you enter. You warrant that you are entitled to process this data and that it is accurate. You will comply with all applicable data protection laws when using the platform.

acceptableUse.title: 5. Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.text: You must not misuse the platform, attempt to access other users' data, interfere with the service, or use it for illegal purposes. Checking QR tickets is only permitted for events you organise or are authorised to manage.

liability.title: 6. Liability
liability.text: We are liable for damages caused by intent and gross negligence as well as for harm to life, body and health. Liability for simple negligence is limited to damages that were foreseeable at the time of contract conclusion, unless it concerns a breach of essential contractual obligations.

law.title: 7. Applicable Law
law.text: These terms are governed by the law of the Federal Republic of Germany. Mandatory legal provisions of the European Union that are affected, in particular for consumers, remain reserved.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains which cookies and browser storage are used by Checkpoint.

essential.title: 1. Essential Cookies
essential.text: Essential cookies are required for the platform to function. These include the locale cookie (remembers your selected language) and authentication cookies (manage your session). These cannot be disabled.

consent.title: 2. Consent Cookie
consent.text: The consent cookie (omnixys.analytics.consent) records whether you have agreed to analytics tracking. It is set for 180 days and can be changed on your secure device settings at any time.

analytics.title: 3. Analytics
analytics.text: With your consent we use an analytics service to measure usage. This is only activated after you have given your consent via the consent banner.

managing.title: 4. Managing Cookies
managing.text: You can change your analytics consent at any time via the device settings in the app. You can also delete cookies and storage in your browser settings; this may restrict functions of the platform.
